label: Topic and input line
note: Conditional Statements. weather = input("Today's weather: ") reads a value typed by the user into the variable weather

label: Plain-language rule
note: If the user types Rain, bring an umbrella; if not, do not bring one. This is the behaviour the code below implements

label: if and elif branches
note: if weather == "Rain": print("Bring Umbrella"), elif weather == "Sunny": print("Wear White Color"). Note the double equals for comparison

label: Condition marker
note: The If that opens the second sentence of the rule

label: else keyword
note: The fallback branch, taken when no earlier condition matched

label: else body
note: print("Just Come") runs for any weather that is neither Rain nor Sunny
